column1: In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere.
column2: 在许多西方国家，围绕人工智能（AI）未来的狂热情绪随处可见。
column3: hysteria|n. 集体狂热；过激情绪

column1: There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity.
column2: 耸人听闻的报道似乎从来不少，都在讲人工智能如何可能治愈疾病、加速人类创新、提升人的创造力。

column1: Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.
column2: 只看媒体标题，你或许会以为那样的未来已经到来，人工智能早已渗透到了社会的方方面面。

column1: While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'.
column2: 不可否认，人工智能开辟了大量前景可期的机会，但它也催生了一种思维方式，称之为“人工智能万能论”最为贴切。

column1: This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems.
column2: 这种观念认为，只要有足够的数据，机器学习算法就能解决人类的一切问题。
column6: machine learning algorithms|机器学习算法

column1: But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.
column2: 然而实际上，这种思维方式并没有推动人工智能进步，反而危及机器智能的价值，因为它忽视了重要的人工智能安全原则，并对人工智能究竟能为人类做些什么抱有不切实际的期望。

column1: In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world.
column2: 短短几年间，“人工智能万能论”就从美国加利福尼亚州硅谷那些技术鼓吹者的口中，传进了世界各地政府官员和政策制定者的脑海。
column4: made its way from|从……一路传来
column5: technology evangelists|技术布道者；技术鼓吹者

column1: The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.
column2: 人们的看法就像钟摆，从一种反乌托邦式的想法——人工智能会毁灭人类——摆向了另一种乌托邦式的信念：我们的算法救星已经降临。

column1: We are now seeing governments pledge support to national AI initiatives and compete in a technological race to dominate the burgeoning machine-learning sector.
column2: 如今，各国政府纷纷承诺支持本国的人工智能计划，并展开技术竞赛，争夺迅速发展的机器学习领域的主导地位。

column1: While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.
column2: 许多政界人士高声宣称，即将到来的“人工智能革命”会带来深远变革，却没有意识到，在现实世界中部署先进的机器学习系统有多复杂。
column5: transformative|adj. 能带来根本变革的

column1: One of the most promising varieties of AI technologies are neural networks.
column2: 神经网络是最有前景的人工智能技术之一。

column1: This form of machine learning is loosely modelled on the neuronal structure of the human brain, but on a much smaller scale.
column2: 这种机器学习方法大致仿照人脑的神经元结构，但规模要小得多。
column9: on a much smaller scale|以小得多的规模

column1: But what many politicians do not understand is that simply adding a neural network to a problem will not automatically mean that you'll find a solution.
column2: 但许多政界人士不明白，仅仅为一个问题引入神经网络，并不意味着就会自动找到解决办法。

column1: Similarly, adding a neural network to a system of government does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair.
column2: 同理，为政府治理体系引入神经网络，也并不意味着它立刻就会变得更包容或更公平。
column5: system of government|政府治理体系

column1: AI systems need a lot of data to function, but the public sector typically does not have the appropriate data infrastructure to support advanced machine learning.
column2: 人工智能系统需要大量数据才能运行，而公共部门通常并不具备支持先进机器学习所需的数据基础设施。
column10: advanced machine learning|先进的机器学习

column1: Most of the data remains stored in offline archives.
column2: 大部分数据仍存放在离线档案中。

column1: The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy.
column2: 现有的少数数字化数据来源，又往往被埋没在层层官僚程序之中。
column8: bureaucracy|n. 官僚体制；繁琐行政程序

column1: More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed.
column2: 数据往往分散在不同的政府部门，访问每个部门的数据都要取得专门许可。
column3: More often than not|往往；多数时候

column1: Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.
column2: 尤其重要的是，公共部门通常缺少具备相应技术能力的人才，因而难以充分发挥机器智能的价值。
column10: reap the benefits of|充分享受……的益处

column1: For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics.
column2: 出于这些原因，针对人工智能的大肆炒作招来了许多批评者。
column3: For these reasons|出于这些原因

column1: Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots.
column2: 加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授斯图尔特·罗素，一直倡导一种更为理性、切合实际的做法，把关注点放在人工智能简单的日常应用上，而非假想中的超级智能机器人接管世界。

column1: Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.
column2: 麻省理工学院机器人学教授罗德尼·布鲁克斯也写道：“几乎所有机器人学和人工智能方面的创新，从出现到真正得到广泛应用，所需的时间都比业内和业外人士想象的长得多、长得多。”
column10: outside the field|在该领域之外

column1: One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks.
column2: 部署机器学习系统面临的诸多困难之一是，人工智能极易受到对抗性攻击。
column5: machine learning systems|机器学习系统

column1: This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions.
column2: 这意味着，一个恶意人工智能系统可以针对另一个人工智能系统，诱使它按特定方式行事，例如迫使它作出错误预测。
column6: in a certain way|按某种特定方式

column1: Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms.
column2: 许多研究者已发出警告，提醒人们不要在缺乏适当安全标准与防御机制的情况下推出人工智能。

column1: Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.
column2: 尽管如此，安装机器学习系统时，人工智能安全仍常常遭到忽视。

column1: If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society.
column2: 如果要利用人工智能带来的好处并尽量减少其潜在危害，我们就必须开始思考，怎样把机器学习切实用于政府、商业和社会领域的具体事务。
column7: meaningfully|adv. 以切实有效的方式

column1: This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.
column2: 这意味着，我们需要讨论人工智能伦理，也需要讨论许多人对机器学习抱有的不信任。

column1: Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead.
column2: 最重要的是，我们需要了解人工智能的局限，并认清在哪些地方仍然需要人来主导。

column1: Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.
column2: 与其把人工智能的力量描绘得不切实际，更重要的是退一步审视，把它真实具备的技术能力和想象区分开来。
column6: take a step back|退一步审视

column1: The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI.
column2: 医疗界也已认识到人工智能的局限。

column1: The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer.
column2: IBM 的沃森肿瘤学项目是一款人工智能程序，原本旨在帮助医生治疗癌症。

column1: Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine.
column2: 尽管开发这款程序的目的是提供最佳建议，专业人员却觉得很难信任这台机器。

column1: As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.
column2: 因此，大部分试用过这款人工智能程序的医院最终都放弃了它。

column1: Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals.
column2: 在法律领域也出现了类似的困难：美国法院曾使用算法给罪犯量刑。

column1: An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing.
column2: 一种算法会计算风险评估分数，并据此向法官提供量刑建议。
column5: risk assessment scores|风险评估分数

column1: The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.
column2: 人们发现，这套系统会加剧结构性种族歧视，后来便弃用了它。

column1: There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes.
column2: 对于所有打算加大国家人工智能项目投资的人来说，这些事例提供了几个关键的教训。

column1: These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything.
column2: 这些例子表明，人工智能无法为所有问题都提供解决办法。

column1: Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it.
column2: 仅仅为了用人工智能而用人工智能，未必总能奏效或产生益处；也并非每个问题都最适合交给机器智能来处理。
column4: for the sake of|为了……本身

column1: All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.
column2: 任何解决方案都有代价，也并非所有可以自动化的事都应该自动化。
column4: come with a cost|要付出代价
